description: Answers the app's preview link: it opens the Development site's private preview on any device, with no Gemmein sign-in — how the founder opens their own preview, and how they show the app to someone. Your preview has one link. Anyone with it can open it. Change the link to cut everyone off. Turn the link off to keep the preview private: then only you can open it, signed in to Gemmein. One link per app, the same each time: asking again answers the same link. It has no end date; it works until it is changed, the preview link is turned off (site_revoke_previews) or the site is unpublished. While it is off, this answers that it is off; on: true turns it back on with a NEW link (anything shared before stays dead). change: true makes a new link — change it to cut off everyone who has it: the old link stops and every device that opened the preview with it is cut off at once (the preview is put up again with nothing else changed); Development allows 20 changes a day. It is short (https://<slug>-dev.gemmein.dev/p/ and ten letters; tell your human: "The link is on your preview's own address."): give it to your human exactly as the answer has it, never re-typed — a link that says it looks incomplete lost letters on the way; ask for it again. A new or changed link is on the founder's Logs. This is what a founder may call a link to show someone, letting a friend try it, or a new link.

change.description: true = a new link; the old one stops working at once. Leave out to get the link as it is.

on.description: true = turn the preview link back on (a new link) after it was turned off. Leave out otherwise.

name: site_share_link
